jobs_results.title: Data Quality Analyst
jobs_results.company_name: Sambodhi Research and Communications Pvt. Ltd.
jobs_results.description:
Company Description
Sambodhi Research and Communications Pvt. Ltd. is a knowledge-based organization that focuses on promoting accountability in the public domain. We provide project management, monitoring & evaluation, and research solutions to implementers, governments, aid agencies, and philanthropic foundations.


Our expertise lies in evaluating large-scale interventions in sectors such as public health, nutrition, sanitation, renewable energy, livelihoods, and microfinance. We are committed to enhancing evidence-based functioning among development organizations and practitioners through initiatives such as the Community of Evaluators-South Asia (CoE-SA) and the South Asian Journal for Evaluation in Practice (SAJEP).


Role Description
This is a full-time remote role for a Data Quality Analyst. The Data Quality Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data through data quality assessments, data governance, and data management activities. The role involves analyzing data, identifying data quality issues, developing and implementing data quality improvement plans, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality standards are met.


Qualifications
Data Quality and Data Governance SkillsAnalytical Skills and Data ManagementData AnalyticsStrong attention to detail and problem-solving skillsProficiency in data analysis tools and techniquesExperience in data quality assessment and improvementKnowledge of data governance frameworks and best practicesAbility to work independently and remotelyExcellent written and verbal communication skillsBachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., data science, statistics, computer science)

jobs_results.title: Financial Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
HDFC Bank is hiring a Financial Data Analyst Intern in Dehradun. This is a hands-on, mentor-led BFSI internship built for students and 2026 freshers who want real exposure to how a private bank actually runs its numbers — not a certificate-only programme.

About the role
As a Financial Data Analyst Intern at HDFC Bank, your core focus will be building BFSI dashboards and analysing customer and portfolio data. You will be attached to a named mentor, join the team's daily stand-ups and reviews, and be trusted with work that genuinely matters rather than filing and formatting. Questions are encouraged, mistakes are treated as teaching moments, and your output is reviewed properly so you actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Support building BFSI dashboards and analysing customer and portfolio data alongside the core private bank team
• Work in Excel and the company's internal systems on live financial data
• Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports that go to real reviewers
• Research companies, customers, products or regulations as the work demands
• Turn your analysis into clear notes and decks for senior stakeholders
• Follow the documentation and control standards a regulated business requires
• Take part in reviews, ask questions and act on the feedback you receive

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning, Statistics, Financial Metrics, Dashboarding, Storytelling with Data — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable finance fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, numerical comfort and care with detail matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc (Stats)/B.Com/MBA based in or willing to work from Dehradun. You should be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, and able to communicate clearly in writing. Relevant coursework, certifications (NISM, CFA L1, GST, Tally) or a strong academic record in SQL will strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 2-month internship in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, with a stipend of ₹28,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a production dashboard used by a business team. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

You will finish this internship able to read a set of financial statements with confidence, work comfortably in Excel at speed, and explain exactly how your work fed a real business decision. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to HDFC Bank's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats for this SQL-focused internship are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Support building BFSI dashboards and analysing customer and portfolio data alongside the core private bank team; Work in Excel and internal systems on live financial data; Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports for senior review; Research companies, customers, products or regulations as required; Present analysis clearly in notes and decks for stakeholders; Follow documentation and control standards required in a regulated business. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc (Stats)/B.Com/MBA — 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong numerical ability and comfort working in MS Excel; Care with detail and the discipline to document work properly; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Dehradun, Uttarakhand.

jobs_results.title: Manufacturing & Quality Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
Tata Advanced Systems has an open Manufacturing & Quality Data Analyst Intern position in Dehradun for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live manufacturing analytics and quality data projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews.

About the role
As a Manufacturing & Quality Data Analyst Intern at Tata Advanced Systems, your core focus will be analysing production, downtime and defect data to lift yield and OEE on the shop floor. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on analysing production, downtime and defect data to lift yield and OEE on the shop floor alongside the core team
• Use Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC), OEE & Downtime Analysis, Root-Cause Analysis (5-Why, Fishbone) on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC), OEE & Downtime Analysis, Root-Cause Analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), Power BI, Quality Metrics (PPM, Yield), Lean & Six Sigma Basics, MES / ERP Data, Report Writing — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Electrical), B.Sc (Statistics) or Diploma + degree based in or willing to work from Dehradun. You should be willing to learn Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC) and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 4-month internship in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, with a stipend of ₹12,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a defect or downtime analysis that improved a line metric. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role.

About this employer — Large enterprise / multinational
Tata Advanced Systems is a large, well-established employer in Aerospace & Defence with a substantial India footprint. Expect a structured internship: formal onboarding, a named mentor, documented processes, defined review checkpoints and the chance to see how analytics works at scale across several business units.
• Employer scale: Large enterprise / multinational
• Industry: Aerospace & Defence
• Careers page: https://www.tataadvancedsystems.com/careers (applications go to the company's own site — MyInternships.in never charges a candidate a fee)

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Electrical), B.Sc (Statistics) or Diploma + degree
• Graduating batch: 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC), OEE & Downtime Analysis, Root-Cause Analysis (5-Why, Fishbone)
• Also useful: Power BI, Quality Metrics (PPM, Yield), Lean & Six Sigma Basics, MES / ERP Data, Report Writing
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 4-6 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours (about 8-9 hours a day) at the office
• Duration: 4 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation, software licences and all tool access are provided at the office — you do not need to bring your own machine
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: Tata Advanced Systems and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Tata Advanced Systems's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on analysing production, downtime and defect data to lift yield and OEE on the shop floor alongside the core team; Apply Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC), OEE & Downtime Analysis to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Electrical), B.Sc (Statistics) or Diploma + degree; Graduating batch 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of Excel, SQL, Statistical Process Control (SPC) (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to OEE & Downtime Analysis, Root-Cause Analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), Power BI is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand or willing to work from there for the internship period.
